Title: Mas’uuliyiinta dalka Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa sheegay in ugu ...

Sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha, dhammaan gantaallada marka laga reebo mid badda ku dhacay ayaa la qabtay lana burburiyay. Sidoo kale ugu yaraan 119 drones ayaa la qabtay, halka labo drone ay ku dhaceen gudaha dhulka Imaaraadka Carabta. Tan iyo markii uu dagaalku bilaabmay, mas’uuliyiintu waxay sheegeen in la ogaaday: 221 gantaal oo ballistic ah, kuwaas oo 205 la burburiyay, 14-na ay badda ku dhaceen, halka labo ay ku dhaceen gudaha dalka Imaaraadka. 1,305 drones oo laga soo diray Iran, kuwaas oo 1,229 la qabtay, halka 76 ay ku dhaceen gudaha dalka. Sidoo kale siddeed gantaal oo cruise ah ayaa la ogaaday laguna guuleystay in la burburiyo. Weeraradan ayaa sababay dhimashada saddex qof oo kala ah muwaadiniin u dhashay Pakistan, Nepal iyo Bangladesh. Waxaa sidoo kale ku dhaawacmay dhaawacyo fudud 112 qof oo ka kala yimid dalal ay ka mid yihiin Imaaraadka, Masar, Itoobiya, Filibiin, Pakistan, Iran, Hindiya, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Azerbaijan, Yemen, Uganda, Eritrea, Lubnaan, Afghanistan, Bahrain, Comoros iyo Turkiga.

Text: Liverpool ayaa dhamaystirtay saxiixa weeraryahanka Newcastle United, Alexander Isak, kadib markii labada kooxood ay ku heshiiyeen lacag rikoor ah oo dhan £125 milyan. Heshiiskan ayaa noqonaya kii ugu qaalisanaa abid ee Premier League, wuxuuna jebinayaa rikoodhkii hore ee £115 milyan oo Chelsea ay sanadkii hore ugu saxiixatay Moisés Caicedo. Isak oo 24 jir ah ayaa xilli ciyaareedkii hore dhaliyay goolal muhiim ah Newcastle, taas oo ka dhigtay mid ka mid ah weeraryahanada ugu qiimaha badan horyaalka Ingiriiska. Iibintiisa ayaa Newcastle ka caawin doonta inay buuxiso shuruudaha dhaqaale ee horyaalka, halka Liverpool ay ku darsanayso weeraryahan awood badan oo mustaqbal dheer leh. Title: Mas’uuliyiinta dalka Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa sheegay in ugu ...
Text: Mas’uuliyiinta dalka Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa sheegay in ugu yaraan 16 gantaal oo ballistic ah iyo 121 diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn (drones) maanta lagu soo weeraray dalka. Sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha, dhammaan gantaallada marka laga reebo mid badda ku dhacay ayaa la qabtay lana burburiyay. Sidoo kale ugu yaraan 119 drones ayaa la qabtay, halka labo drone ay ku dhaceen gudaha dhulka Imaaraadka Carabta. Tan iyo markii uu dagaalku bilaabmay, mas’uuliyiintu waxay sheegeen in la ogaaday: 221 gantaal oo ballistic ah, kuwaas oo 205 la burburiyay, 14-na ay badda ku dhaceen, halka labo ay ku dhaceen gudaha dalka Imaaraadka. 1,305 drones oo laga soo diray Iran, kuwaas oo 1,229 la qabtay, halka 76 ay ku dhaceen gudaha dalka. Sidoo kale siddeed gantaal oo cruise ah ayaa la ogaaday laguna guuleystay in la burburiyo. Weeraradan ayaa sababay dhimashada saddex qof oo kala ah muwaadiniin u dhashay Pakistan, Nepal iyo Bangladesh. Waxaa sidoo kale ku dhaawacmay dhaawacyo fudud 112 qof oo ka kala yimid dalal ay ka mid yihiin Imaaraadka, Masar, Itoobiya, Filibiin, Pakistan, Iran, Hindiya, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Azerbaijan, Yemen, Uganda, Eritrea, Lubnaan, Afghanistan, Bahrain, Comoros iyo Turkiga.

Title: Mas’uuliyiinta dalka Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa sheegay in ugu ...
Text: Mas’uuliyiinta dalka Imaaraadka Carabta ayaa sheegay in ugu yaraan 16 gantaal oo ballistic ah iyo 121 diyaaradood oo aan duuliye lahayn (drones) maanta lagu soo weeraray dalka. Sida ay sheegeen saraakiisha, dhammaan gantaallada marka laga reebo mid badda ku dhacay ayaa la qabtay lana burburiyay. Sidoo kale ugu yaraan 119 drones ayaa la qabtay, halka labo drone ay ku dhaceen gudaha dhulka Imaaraadka Carabta. Tan iyo markii uu dagaalku bilaabmay, mas’uuliyiintu waxay sheegeen in la ogaaday: 221 gantaal oo ballistic ah, kuwaas oo 205 la burburiyay, 14-na ay badda ku dhaceen, halka labo ay ku dhaceen gudaha dalka Imaaraadka. 1,305 drones oo laga soo diray Iran, kuwaas oo 1,229 la qabtay, halka 76 ay ku dhaceen gudaha dalka. Sidoo kale siddeed gantaal oo cruise ah ayaa la ogaaday laguna guuleystay in la burburiyo. Weeraradan ayaa sababay dhimashada saddex qof oo kala ah muwaadiniin u dhashay Pakistan, Nepal iyo Bangladesh. Waxaa sidoo kale ku dhaawacmay dhaawacyo fudud 112 qof oo ka kala yimid dalal ay ka mid yihiin Imaaraadka, Masar, Itoobiya, Filibiin, Pakistan, Iran, Hindiya, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Azerbaijan, Yemen, Uganda, Eritrea, Lubnaan, Afghanistan, Bahrain, Comoros iyo Turkiga.
